subject: physics
pageCoverage: The page teaches the drag equation and which factors change drag.

overview.headline: Drag rises with speed squared, density, area and coefficient.

keyPoints.point: The drag equation collects density, speed, area and coefficient in one relation.
keyPoints.quote: drag D is equal to the drag coefficient Cd times the density rho

keyPoints.point: The variable called the drag coefficient packs the complex shape and flow effects together.
keyPoints.quote: this variable is called the drag coefficient, designated

keyPoints.point: The area in the equation is a stated reference area for the body.
keyPoints.quote: the area (A) given in the drag equation is given as a reference area

keyTerms.gloss: Variable called the drag coefficient, collecting shape and flow effects.
keyTerms.quote: this variable is called the drag coefficient, designated

keyTerms.gloss: Mass of air per volume, designated by the letter rho.
keyTerms.quote: density is designated by the letter rho

keyTerms.gloss: Density and velocity combination from the equation.
keyTerms.quote: density times the square of the velocity divided by two

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Students predict speed squared scaling before moving sliders.
Checks which factors raise or lower drag on the page.
componentPlan.focusQuote: Drag depends on the density of the air
